verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HeyGen publishing its own MCP server so that outside agents like Claude and Cursor can call HeyGen. That is the server role, a different story, and it earns no credit here. Nothing shows HeyGen or its Video Agent acting as an MCP client that can connect to user-supplied MCP servers and use their tools. Since an agentic video platform could plausibly offer this, the axis applies, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
